changes: Replace automatic banner with typed green/orange/red status dot and manually opened source details.
Timestamp-aware isolated personal native clock and continuous WebView clock; immediate seeks/pause/rate changes.
Remove overlay/window work from native clock polling and reduce bridge traffic; honor window visibility.
Retain lyric DOM and avoid repeated parsing for equivalent source replies; wait for parsing before noLyrics.
Support normal verification message callback and Retry-After; actual Java broker access returns all six providers.
Bounded recording-free frame-callback diagnostics in existing Source diagnostics.
limitations: No phone performance or Android WebView verification acceptance; no universal zero-stutter claim.
Desktop4x CPU results varied under concurrent load; the84ms/two-long-task rich run is retained alongside uncontended0-long-task cases.
Frame callback gaps are not GPU/display dropped-frame measurements and refresh transitions can affect them.
Native cold presentation/alternate recording-time limitations remain; no Shaders, device/MuMu, signing or installation operations.
